categories: The workspace.selected event carries the platform-specific isolated capture working directory.
The canonical bootstrap surface uses a UUID while the Windows bootstrap surface retains the stable legacy id surface-1.
platform_equivalences.strict_guards: Only /events/1/payload/cwd and /events/2/payload/previous_surface_id in notification.open_target are approved. Responses, errors, selectors, notification state, target identity, ordering, event names and order, CLI help, CLI output, and every other field remain strict.

verification.cli_unit_suite: 259 passed, 0 failed, plus all CLI integration suites
verification.differential_comparison: 31 of 31 cases exact after pointer-scoped normalization, repeated twice
verification.format_and_whitespace: cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check passed
verification.capture_process: Owned hidden process with a pre-armed descendant-window watchdog; no visible-window violation and all owned app, watchdog, Vite, listener, and port-1420 processes stopped.

organization.result: The former mixed activity controller no longer owns notification mutations or navigation; notification events, store wire contracts, CLI help, mutations, and navigation have bounded responsibility modules.

promotion.reason: The fourteen public entry points have retained exact behavioral evidence for help and parsing, defaults, validation, errors, list formatting, target navigation, unread mutations, workspace reorder-on-notification, lifecycle events, and state probes. Specialized create variants, reconcile, delivery/persistence, and the broad product umbrella remain outside this lane and are not promoted.
